REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No: 454/33 STR
13 H 5 A 3/10
Hongkew Station,
Date Oct. 17th 1933
Subject (in full) Public Safety Bureau Officers using Municipal Road to carry out raid.
Made by D.S.I. Crawford. Forwarded by D.I. A. Telfer.
Sir,
At 9.50 p.m. 17-10-33, C.P.C. 50 on E. Post Haskell Road & Range Road telephoned Hongkew Station that officers of the Public Safety Bureau had arrived on Haskell Road in four m/cars and were conducting a raid on premises in An Ning Lee off Haskell Road.
D.S.I. Crawford, D.S. Golobkoff, and C.L.C. attended and found four private motor cars drawn up, facing South on Haskell Road outside the An Ning Lee alleyway. The motor cars were North of iron gates on the boundary.
Superintendent Paul King (丁順寶) of Headquarters, Public Safety Bureau was met at the entrance to the alleyway and informed the undersigned that he had conducted a raid on House No.10 (Chinese number) in the An Ning Lee alleyway, which is under Chinese jurisdiction just North of the Settlement boundary and arrested 19 male Chinese for gambling, they had also seized two trays of opium paraphernalia.
While the above detectives were there two raiding vans belonging to the Public Safety Bureau arrived, via Range Road turning North into Haskell Road and stopping outside the An Ning Lee, the arrested persons being put into these vans which drove off North on Haskell Road into Chinese territory.
The Public Safety Bureau party consisted seven detectives and one uniform policeman belonging the 5th Division, 1st station.
I am, Sir
Your obedient servant,
E. Crawford

报告
上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案编号：454/33 STR
13 H 5 A 3/10
虹口巡捕房，
日期：1933年10月17日
事由（全称）：公安局警官使用市政道路进行搜捕行动。
呈报人：副督察长克劳福德（Crawford）。转呈人：督察长 A. 泰尔弗（A. Telfer）。

阁下：

1933年10月17日晚上9时50分，驻守东哈斯克尔路（E. Post Haskell Road）与兰格路（Range Road）交口的中央巡捕岗亭50号致电虹口巡捕房，称公安局警官已乘坐四辆摩托车抵达哈斯克尔路，并正在对哈斯克尔路旁安宁里（An Ning Lee）内的处所进行搜捕。

副督察长克劳福德、副探长戈洛布科夫（Golobkoff）及华籍领班巡长到场，发现四辆私人汽车停在哈斯克尔路上、安宁里弄堂口外，车头朝南。这些汽车位于边界铁门以北。

在弄堂入口处遇到了公安局总部 superintendent 丁顺宝（Paul King），他告知本人，他对位于租界边界以北、属中国管辖的安宁里弄堂内第10号（中式门牌）房屋进行了搜捕，并以赌博罪名逮捕了19名中国男子，他们还查获了两盘鸦片烟具。

当上述侦探在场时，两辆属于公安局的搜捕车经兰格路向北转入哈斯克尔路，停在安宁里外，被捕人员被带上这些车辆，随后车辆沿哈斯克尔路向北驶入中国地界。

公安局一行由七名侦探和一名隶属于第五区第一分站的制服警员组成。

此致
阁下之恭顺仆人，
E. 克劳福德
